title: OPA Gatekeeper：約束模板與政策單元測試
titleEn: OPA Gatekeeper: constraint templates and policy unit tests
subcategoryTitle: 雲端政策、稽核與組態治理
subcategoryTitleEn: Cloud policy, auditing and configuration governance
summary: 區分ConstraintTemplate、Constraint與實際物件，對允許、拒絕、欄位缺失及例外建立測試。
summaryEn: Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 只測有欄位的物件會掩蓋缺值路徑；模板更新後舊Constraint也需重新驗證。
修正後跑全套並固定引擎與API版本，先觀察再阻擋；不要將所有錯誤都改成允許。
Gatekeeper 將OPA政策接到準入控制；本課把參數化規則與測試物件分開保存。
optionsEn: Testing only populated objects misses missing-field paths; existing Constraints need revalidation after template changes.
Run the entire suite after fixes with pinned engine and API versions, observe before enforcing, and never turn every error into allow.
Gatekeeper connects OPA policy to admission control; keep parameterized rules separate from test objects.

steps.instruction:

Return to the investigation: Gatekeeper connects OPA policy to admission control; keep parameterized rules separate from test objects. Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。先驗證參數schema，再核對缺值與空字串行為；每個測試保存輸入、參數與預期原因。

steps.objective: 完成「模板參數邊界」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Template parameter boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
只測有欄位的物件會掩蓋缺值路徑；模板更新後舊Constraint也需重新驗證。
對照「模板參數邊界」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。修正後跑全套並固定引擎與API版本，先觀察再阻擋；不要將所有錯誤都改成允許。
本階段必須重驗：區分ConstraintTemplate、Constraint與實際物件，對允許、拒絕、欄位缺失及例外建立測試。
steps.instructionEn:
Testing only populated objects misses missing-field paths; existing Constraints need revalidation after template changes.
Against the nominal Template parameter boundary result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Run the entire suite after fixes with pinned engine and API versions, observe before enforcing, and never turn every error into allow.
Reverify this criterion: Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。只測有欄位的物件會掩蓋缺值路徑；模板更新後舊Constraint也需重新驗證。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Testing only populated objects misses missing-field paths; existing Constraints need revalidation after template changes.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Template parameter boundary and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付模板、參數、16個測試與兩個缺值反例的修正證據。
在交接件中加入「模板參數邊界」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：區分ConstraintTemplate、Constraint與實際物件，對允許、拒絕、欄位缺失及例外建立測試。

steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the template, parameters, sixteen tests and repair evidence for the two missing-field counterexamples.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Template parameter boundary: Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。區分ConstraintTemplate、Constraint與實際物件，對允許、拒絕、欄位缺失及例外建立測試。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
